+# Deployment
+
+Every commit merged to main is deployed to production
+automatically; no human action is involved.
+
+## Environments
+
+Production deploys require approval from the release team — the
+production environment carries required reviewers; staging deploys
+are fully automatic.

note: Isolated defect: 'no human action is involved' contradicts the required production approval documented in the same file.
